about.title: About the Into the Inklands set
paragraphs: Into the Inklands is the 3rd Disney Lorcana booster set, released on 8 March 2024. It has 227 cards: 208 in the main set, 18 Enchanted and 1 Illumineer’s Quest cards. There are also 208 foils, one for each main set card.

Choose what you’re collecting: the Standard set (the 208 main set cards), the Master set (416 cards, adding the foils) or the Grand Master set (all 435 cards, adding the Enchanted and Illumineer’s Quest cards).

This free checklist lets you tick off the cards you own, count spare copies for trading, see your progress by rarity and plan your binder pages. It works on phones and computers, even offline, and your collection stays on your device.
Card details come from LorcanaJSON, card images from Lorcast and prices from TCGplayer.
